title: Greater Latrobe Wildcats
subtitle: Kingston, Quebec city, and montreal June 6-12, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Greater Latrobe Wildcats. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel Day to Kingston, ON

  • Travel to Kingston, ON!
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Guided Ghost Tour- Original Haunted Walk of Kingston
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (six nights)
 

Day 2: Walking Tour of Upper Town & Professional photo at Dufferin Terrace

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Upper Town
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Professional Group Photo at Dufferin Terrace
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Musée de la Civilisation du Quebec & The Battles at Plaines D’Abraham

  • Group sit-down breakfast 
  • Guided Tour of Musée de la Civilisation du Quebec
  • Free time and Lunch on your own in Quartier Petit Champlain
  • Visit the Observatoire de la Capitale
  • Guided Tour of The Battles at Plaines D’Abraham
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations and swimming at the hotel!
 

Day 4: Basilique Saint Anne de Beaupré & Montmorency Falls 

  • Group sit-down breakfast
  • Visit the Morrin Center- Discovery Tour 
  • Picnic Lunch 
  • Guided Tour of Basilique Saint Anne de Beaupré
  • Visit the Montmorency Falls 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 5: Old Montreal Walking Tour & Biodome Espace

  • Group sit-down breakfast 
  • Travel to Montreal! 
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Orientation of Old Montreal 
  • Visit the Biodome- Espace pour la vie 
  • Group sit-down dinner 
  • Visit the Kondiaronk Lookout at Mount Royal 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 

Day 6: Notre-Dame Basilica of Montréal & Pointe-á-Callière

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Notre-Dame Basilica of Montréal 
  • Visit Voiles en Voiles
  • Lunch 
  • Visit Pointe-á-Callière
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Cirque du Soleil ECHO

Day 7: Souvenir shopping and Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel 
  • Souvenir shopping 
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Greater Latrobe Wildcats, get ready for an unforgettable Kingston, Quebec City, and Montreal adventure in 2027!
introText: From historic streets and dramatic landscapes to vibrant culture and unforgettable performances, this journey through Kingston, Ontario, Quebec City, and Montreal brings history and discovery to life at every turn. Students will explore centuries-old fortifications and charming Old Towns, take in stunning views from scenic lookouts, experience immersive museums, and enjoy iconic Canadian highlights like Montmorency Falls and Old Montreal. With a blend of cultural exploration, hands-on learning, and exciting attractions, this trip offers the perfect mix of education and adventure—an experience your students will never forget.
